messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 3 messages:

[2025-09-03T13:00:00Z] customer (Lena Fischer): Cancel my annual plan please, I bought it by mistake 5 days ago.
[2025-09-03T13:20:00Z] internal_note (Sam (HelpHub)): Within 14-day window, so full refund. Customer paid 1,188.00 EUR. Needs finance approval above 1,000.
[2025-09-03T13:22:00Z] agent (Sam (HelpHub)): Hi Lena, I have asked our finance team to approve the full refund. I will confirm tomorrow.

message.content:
Issue: Customer requests cancellation of annual plan purchased by mistake 5 days ago. Refund eligible within 14-day window. Finance approval required for amount over 1,000 EUR.

Tried so far: Agent submitted finance approval request for full refund of 1,188.00 EUR. Awaiting confirmation.

Next step: Agent to follow up with finance team and confirm refund status to customer tomorrow.
